title: IBM Secure Proxy 6.1.0.0 through 6.2.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service due…
description: IBM Secure Proxy versions 6.1.0.0 through 6.2.1.2 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service. The issue arises from improper validation of the listener IP address and port, which can be exploited to disrupt service availability.
